title: Elements
lead: Every accessibility component, live. Each one enhances real markup authored in this page's template; use the keyboard and a screen reader to see what they add.
anchor-desc: Enhances a real <a href>. New-tab links get rel="noopener noreferrer" and "(opens in new tab)" in their accessible name. Same-page links smooth-scroll, move focus to the target, and announce the jump.
avatar-desc: An avatar image with an initials fallback, shown when there is no src or when the image fails to load. Circle by default, or square.
checkbox-desc: Wraps a real <input type="checkbox"> in a label with a visible label span. Adds an indeterminate state and an onChange callback.
focusable-desc: The escape hatch for an element that can't be a real <button>: role="button", keyboard-focusable, and Enter/Space trigger a real click.
input-desc: Wraps a real <input> with optional <a11y-label>, <a11y-hint> and <a11y-error> parts, and links them with for and aria-describedby. Native constraints do the validating: an error shows once a field is left after an edit, or when a submit finds it invalid, then updates as you type. On submit, the first invalid field is focused.
input-username-hint: At least 3 characters, no spaces. The no-spaces rule is a custom validator on top of the native minlength.
input-submitted: Submitted, and the form was reset.
label-desc: Renders a real <label> around its content. Inside a field it's linked automatically; on its own, for is forwarded, so clicking it focuses the input.
picture-desc: Wraps a real <picture>. It hides the image from assistive tech automatically when the image is decorative (empty alt and no caption), as with the second image.
picture-caption: An informative image with a caption
progress-desc: A progress bar named by its visible label through aria-labelledby.
radio-group-desc: Wraps real radio inputs sharing a name in a fieldset with a legend. The native same-name grouping keeps them mutually exclusive.
select-desc: Wraps a real <select> in a label with a visible label span. The browser's own picker and keyboard handling stay untouched.
skeleton-desc: A loading placeholder shape, with no JavaScript required: circle, text lines, or rect.
spinner-desc: A loading spinner with an accessible label. The last one is scoped to a different color with an inline --a11y-spinner-color custom property.
switch-desc: A real checkbox exposed as role="switch", with the same label wrapping as the checkbox.
textarea-desc: The same field parts around a real <textarea>. An <a11y-counter> shows the length against maxlength, and announces the characters left near the limit.
textarea-missing: Tell us a bit about yourself
visually-hidden-desc: Content present for assistive tech but visually hidden. The icon-only button below is announced as "Delete item".
